blinded.text: Hey! Turn off your high beams, pal! Are you trying to blind me before the handover?

choices.text: "Sorry about that. Here's the encrypted data-chip."
"Hold your horses. I'm still holding the chip."

start.text: You got the encrypted data-chip from the Syndicate boss?

choices.text: "Here's the data-chip. Hand over the payment."

deliver_package.text: Data verifies clean. 500 Credits transferred directly to your neural wallet. Good doing business with you.
